name: ISO-Bench
description: ISO-Bench is a benchmark for coding agents to evaluate their ability to optimize real-world inference workloads by producing code patches that improve performance on tasks derived from popular LLM serving frameworks.
reputation: A very recent niche benchmark for coding agents focused on real-world inference optimization, with limited community adoption so far.
notes: Combines hard execution metrics and soft LLM-based metrics to evaluate optimization patches.
